description: Digamma function psi(x) = gamma'(x) / gamma(x) for real x

tolerance.reason: For x > 0 the value is well conditioned except next to the zero x0 = 1.4616..., where careful implementations (Boost, SciPy) expand in x - x0 with x0 held to extra precision, so the exact input still gives a result to a few ulps; the grid has the double nearest x0 and x0 +- 1e-5, 1e-10 to test this. For x < 0 the reflection formula psi(1 - x) - pi cot(pi x) subtracts two terms; rounding them costs (|term 1| + |term 2|) / |result| times 2^-53, at most 1313 on this grid (x = -22.75, near a zero at -22.7502), so up to 1.5e-13 is unavoidable. 4e-13 allows 2.7x that, as for gammaln. SciPy's worst error is 2.8e-13, at that point; elsewhere 2.2e-14

grid: x = -30..180 step 0.25 (poles at 0, -1, ..., -30) and +-10^k for k = -300..-10 step 10 (the gamma grid), plus 10^k for k = 0..300 step 10, x = 1e305, 2e305, 2.5e305, 2.6e305, 1e306, 1e307, 1e308 and the largest double, x = -100.5, -1000.25, -10000.5, -1000000.5, -999999999999999.5, and next to the positive zero x0 = 1.46163...: the double nearest x0 and x0 +- d for d in {1e-5, 1e-10} (rounded to doubles)
